title: Introduction to Machine Learning
author: Ethem Alpaydin
subject: Machine Learning
description: Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, decision trees, neural networks, and evaluation metrics. Suitable for undergraduate-level ML courses.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
subject: Deep Learning
description: Comprehensive reference on deep neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, and generative models. Graduate-level depth.

title: Database System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz
subject: Database Systems
description: Standard textbook on relational databases, SQL, normalization, transactions, and indexing.

title: Operating System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz
subject: Operating Systems
description: Covers process management, memory management, file systems, and concurrency.

title: Speech and Language Processing
author: Daniel Jurafsky, James H. Martin
subject: Natural Language Processing
description: Foundational NLP text covering tokenization, parsing, language models, and modern transformer-based approaches.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: The canonical AI textbook covering search, logic, planning, and probabilistic reasoning alongside modern ML.

title: Computer Networks
author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum
subject: Computer Networks
description: Layered network architecture, TCP/IP, routing protocols, and network security fundamentals.

title: Financial Technology and the Future of Finance
author: Pranay Gupta
subject: Fintech
description: Overview of digital lending, payments infrastructure, and regulatory frameworks in the Indian fintech ecosystem.
